Overrides: {"drive_mW":0.01,"fidelity":1,"front_plug":"mesh","load":"iec60318_4_damped","rear_plug":"mesh","residual_leak_gap_mm":0.01,"source_impedance_ohm":0}. A damped IEC 60318-4 simulator (for example GRAS RA0401/RA0402, which the manufacturer states complies with IEC 60318-4 from 100 Hz to 10 kHz with the 13.5 kHz resonance damped). The engine has no model of the damping: the prediction is the undamped model, frozen and compared up to 10 kHz only.
